## Expression on this line

Epistemic at amber Stage 9 is the **truth-regime of in-group-sanctioned authority**: a
knowledge claim is validated by concordance with the group's sanctioned-source (the text, the
party, the tradition, the institution). Modern institutions-of-knowledge have consolidated —
publishing, journals, libraries, archives, modern universities, official statistics-bureaus,
modern newsrooms — but the operating logic is that of *the authority-of-the-sanctioned*:
who-warrants-trust is defined by group-membership and concordance with the sanctioned-source.
Out-of-the-line evidence is filtered, primarily as *foreign-attack* or *corrupting-non-true*.

The constitutive choice is to organize the epistemic-domain around the *in-group's sanctioned-
authority*. The modern institutions-of-knowledge are real-and-competent — but they operate
within a frame-of-the-sacred-authority whose claims-take-precedence-over-merely-evidential-
disciplines. Disciplines-of-evidence-and-method exist but are operationalized within the
sacred-authority-frame.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion — what a higher CoG must keep from amber-9)

- **UL:** the practitioner's professional craftsmanship — the disciplined-feel of the craft of
  the writer, scholar, or journalist.
- **UR:** modern institutions-of-knowledge infrastructure; publishing, journals, libraries,
  archives, modern universities, official statistics-bureaus, modern newsrooms.
- **LL:** shared-effective-state-of-the-discipline-of-the-discipline-of-the-discipline-discipline
  standard — the shared-statistical-sanction-of-evidence-discipline that earlier stages cannot
  produce.
- **LR:** codified-research-disciplines, institutional-discipline-of-peer-review,
  discipline-of-statistical-or-archival-of-state-statistical-discipline, professional-and-
  journalistic-discipline, codified-statistical-discipline.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to amber-9):** **knowledge-as-in-group-authority** — the
  epistemic-domain organizes its energy around defending the in-group's sanctioned-authority;
  out-group-discipline is filtered as foreign-attack; the in-group's-discipline becomes the
  measure-of-truth.
- **Dark allergy (amber-9 foundation skipped/fragile):** modern-institutions-of-knowledge
  infrastructure without a discipline-of-evidence-statistical-of-evidence: infrastructure-
  without-tradition-continuity.
- **Golden addiction (grasping Orange prematurely):** **statistical-discipline-theater** —
  adoption of inquiry-disciplines and -vocabulary (peer-review, evidence-statistical, public-
  statistic-trend) when the operative logic remains in-group-sanctioned-authority.
- **Golden allergy (Jonah / refusing the Orange emergence):** nativist-refusal of *knowledge-as-
  a public-domain bound by rights-equality-procedure*: "we use our own knowledge",
  refusing the worldcentric turn toward evidence-as-public-domain.

## Diagnostic cues (universal signal-types)

Falsifiable signal *types* that place an epistemic-system holon at **amber Stage 9**.

- **In-group-aligned-default-knowledge-statistical.** Patterns-of-evidence-discipline-statistical
  in published-public-discipline-statistics-of-evidence-statistical-discipline favor in-group
  claims-of-knowledge; out-group-discipline-of-knowledge-statistical-case-trend rated lower.
- **In-group-affiliated-source-statistical.** Patterns-of-cited-and-quoted sources-statistical
  favor in-group-affiliated-authorities; out-group-affiliated-authorities statistically-rare.
- **Statutory-discipline-targeting-out-group aligned with disciplinary-discipline-of-the-state.**
  Patterns-of-statutory-discipline-discipline-of-the-applied discipline publish-on-out-group-
  aligned-statistical-discipline-as-foreign-attack-or-statistical-unreliable.
- **Peer-review-statistical-discipline in-group-coordinated.** Peer-review-discipline routinely-
  in-group-coordinated; effective-coordinated-statistical-trends.
- **Disciplinary-discursive-coverage-routine of in-group-aligned-claims.** Public-disciplineof-claims
  routinely-of-in-group-aligned-discipline, with evidence-discipline-use occasionally-statistical-
  rare-versus-in-group-aligned-discipline.
- **Discipline-of-the-discipline-of-the-discipline-statistical-ratchet.** Discipline-disciplines
  occasionally-statistical-discipline-statistical-of-evidence-discipline (no disqualification
  discipline, no statistic-of-claimed-coverage).
